result.title: MFlowHOI: Whole-Body Human-Object Interaction Generation via Part-Aware MeanFlow
result.summary: Whole-body human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires coordinating body and finger motion, object trajectories, and time-varying contacts. Existing methods typically rely on iterative diffusion or test-time optimization, resulting in high inference costs. Direct one-step generation is highly desired in downstream applications due to efficient inference. However, it is challenging because these HOI components differ substantially in structure and scale. We present MFlowHOI, an efficient one-step framework for whole-body HOI generation. A Contact-Aware Multipart RVQVAE organizes body, hand, object, and contact signals into a structured latent space, with a shared decoder preserving their global coordination. An ST-DiT then models temporal and cross-part dependencies in this space and generates a complete interaction in a single MeanFlow evaluation. Predicted object-local contact correspondences further enable geometric refinement and interaction-preserving transfer to photorealistic 3D Gaussian avatars with different body proportions. Experiments demonstrate that MFlowHOI outperforms existing base generators in motion quality and text alignment while substantially reducing inference time.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MFlowHOI：用接触感知的多部件 RVQVAE 将身体、手、物体与接触信号编入结构化 latent 空间，再由 ST-DiT 在一次 MeanFlow 评估中直接生成完整的人–物交互轨迹。
AI.relevance_reason: 其多部件结构化 latent 加共享解码器的设计，可供核查 LVR 中「表示是否保留任务必要信息、避免信息坍缩」，而一步 MeanFlow 替代迭代扩散，可能为 parallel 式 latent 推理状态的生成与更新成本权衡提供线索；但属动作生成领域，迁移性需自行判断。
